description.value: Phad Thai Restaurant is a full-service Thai eatery on the Trans-Canada Highway in Duncan, sitting directly on the main cycling corridor through the Cowichan Valley. The menu spans classic Thai cooking—curries, pad thai, stir-fries, noodle dishes, soups, and appetizers—with vegetarian options clearly flagged in the menu legend. Online ordering with pickup and delivery is available through the restaurant's own website.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at phadthaiduncan.com loaded successfully and confirms the business is an active Thai restaurant at 270 Trans-Canada Hwy, Duncan, BC V9L3P9 with phone +12505973222. The menu page explicitly labels a 'vegetarian' legend category with multiple vegetarian items, and the ordering system confirms pickup (takeout) is available. No website content addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities, so those are null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Phad Thai' but the website consistently uses 'Phad Thai Restaurant'; no address or phone in OSM tags, both sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active Thai restaurant on the Trans-Canada Highway in Duncan—a key cycling route through the Cowichan Valley—with confirmed takeout, vegetarian options, and online ordering. A practical meal stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page legend explicitly lists 'vegetarian' as a category marker; multiple dishes are identified as vegetarian including Vegetarian Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Pad Thai, and vegetarian curry/soup options
